name: FIRST (Forum of Incident Response and Security Teams)
description: Premier global organization for incident response teams with 800+ member organizations. Maintains CVSS (industry-standard vulnerability scoring), EPSS, TLP, and CSIRT/PSIRT frameworks.

peerReview.processDescription: CVSS maintained through CVSS-SIG with extensive peer review by global security experts. EPSS: Data-driven model maintained through peer-reviewed research. CSIRT/PSIRT Frameworks developed through member consensus. 800+ member organizations.

attribution.attributionNotes: FIRST membership is invitation-only with organizational peer review. CVSS scores are the global standard for vulnerability severity.

povsAlignment.description: Global incident response organization maintaining CVSS standard through member consensus.
